## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-fascicle Chen-dynasty translation of the *Suvikrāntavikrāmiparipṛcchā Prajñāpāramitā* — a Mahāyāna *paripṛcchā*-form *prajñā* sūtra. Translated by Upaśūnya 月婆首那 in 565 CE. Signature: 「陳優禪尼國王子月婆首那譯」. The Taishō header cross-references [T220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0001)(6) — [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng's later integration as the sixth *huì* of [T220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0001).

**Abstract**

T231 is the only stand-alone Chinese translation of the *Suvikrāntavikrāmi-paripṛcchā Prajñāpāramitā*; the same Indic source is preserved in [T220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0001) as the sixth *huì*. Sanskrit edition: Hikata 1958. The *Suvikrāntavikrāmin* is one of the Mahāyāna *prajñā*-paripṛcchā class sūtras with the *bodhisattva* king as the questioner; doctrinally compatible with the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* tradition. The translation is dated to *Tàijiàn* 太建 1 = 565 CE in the Chen capital at Yángzhōu.
